name: sonny
description: Personal AI backend for Kevin & Kylie — meal planning, notes, recipes, calendar, and pantry.

auth.description: Pass Authorization: Bearer <token> on every request. Token is KEVIN_SECRET or KYLIE_SECRET from environment.

tools.name: get_meal_plan
tools.description: Return the current active meal plan from Redis, including all planned meals and serving count.

tools.name: swap_meal
tools.description: Swap one meal in the active plan for a different recipe. Provide targetSlug (the recipeSlug to replace) or a natural-language message like 'swap the pasta'. Clears the grocery cache.

targetSlug.description: The recipeSlug of the meal to replace. Skip Haiku identification when known.

message.description: Natural-language swap request (e.g. 'swap the chicken dish'). Used when targetSlug is not provided.

preferences.description: Optional flavour hint for the replacement (e.g. 'something quick', 'vegetarian').

tools.name: get_grocery_list
tools.description: Return the grocery list for the active meal plan. Builds and caches automatically if not already cached. Returns items grouped by category and a checkedItems list.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Semantic search over the authenticated user's Pinecone notes namespace (kevin-notes or kylie-notes), plus shared namespaces.

query.description: The search query (embedded and compared against stored notes).

topK.description: Max results to return. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: save_note
tools.description: Save a note to the authenticated user's Pinecone namespace. Prefix with a date for temporal recall (e.g. 'April 17, 2026: ...').

text.description: The note text to embed and store.

tools.name: add_recipe
tools.description: Fetch a recipe page by URL, extract structured recipe data via Haiku, and save it to Redis.

url.description: Full URL of the recipe page (e.g. https://www.bonappetit.com/recipe/...).

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: Return all recipes stored in Redis as a JSON array.

tools.name: get_upcoming_events
tools.description: Return upcoming iCloud calendar events as formatted text. Requires CalDAV to be configured.

days.description: How many days ahead to fetch. Defaults to 7, max 30.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Create an event in the configured iCloud write calendar. startLocal and endLocal use format YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS for timed events or YYYYMMDD for all-day.

startLocal.description: Start time in local time. Format: YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS (timed) or YYYYMMDD (all-day).

endLocal.description: End time in local time. Same format as startLocal.

allDay.description: True for all-day events. Defaults to false.

tools.name: get_pantry
tools.description: Return the current pantry staples list (shared between Kevin and Kylie). These items are excluded from grocery list generation.

tools.name: update_pantry
tools.description: Add or remove items from the shared pantry staples list.

action.description: Whether to add or remove the items.

items.description: List of ingredient names to add or remove.
